system_overview: This specification extends Dijkstra's ring-based termination detection algorithm (EWD840) with SVG-based animation capabilities. It generates graphical representations of the ring network, token position, node states, and message flows at each step, enabling visual exploration and debugging of the algorithm's execution.
actors_and_components: The system consists of the same N nodes arranged in a ring as the base EWD840 specification, augmented with a visualization layer. The visualization renders nodes as squares (rounded when active) colored according to their state, a token circle on a larger concentric ring showing the token's position and color, and lollipop lines showing message sends between nodes. A legend displays the current step number and visual encoding conventions.
state_variables: All state variables from the base EWD840 specification are inherited (node activation status, node colors, token position, token color). An additional history variable records the sender, receiver, and action type of the most recent step for message visualization purposes.
initial_state: The initial state constrains the token to always start at position N-1 (instead of an arbitrary position as in the base spec) and initializes the history variable. Node activation and color states remain nondeterministic.
actions: All base EWD840 actions are wrapped to additionally update the history variable: initiate probe, pass token, send message, and deactivate. The history variable records the action type and the involved sender/receiver for message visualization.
model_bounds: An animation invariant constrains traces so that termination detection triggers before step 20, producing traces of interesting length for visualization. The number of nodes N must be instantiated as a constant.
additional_assumptions: Requires the SVG, TLC, Sequences, and Integers community modules. The animation output can be viewed using the TLA+ trace animator web application or rendered to animated GIF/video formats using command-line tools.
